question: zones intersecting bbox -74.02 40.70 -73.93 40.80
sql: SELECT zone, borough FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.70, -73.93, 40.80)) ORDER BY zone, location_id;

question: count pickups in bbox -73.87 40.74 -73.77 40.80
sql: SELECT count(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.87, 40.74, -73.77, 40.80));

question: extent of brooklyn zone polygons
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS brooklyn_bbox FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE borough = 'Brooklyn';

question: zones fully inside bbox -74.30 40.45 -74.00 40.70
sql: SELECT zone, borough FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.30, 40.45, -74.00, 40.70)) ORDER BY zone, location_id;

question: dropoff zone counts within bbox -74.02 40.70 -73.75 40.82
sql: SELECT z.zone, count(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.DOLocationID = z.location_id WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.70, -73.75, 40.82)) GROUP BY z.zone ORDER BY trips DESC, z.zone;

question: bounding box of Woodlawn/Wakefield zone
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS zone_bbox FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE zone = 'Woodlawn/Wakefield';
